plain: To commit a crime or harmful act

webster.text: To do; to commit; to perform; in an ill sense, that is, always used to express an evil act; as, to perpetrate a crime or an evil design.

example.quote: By the very persons who advised him to perpetrate the act.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
